insights: Space and aerospace shorts achieve the highest engagement and view counts, with NASA and orbital mechanics topics (e.g., Europa Clipper scoring 1.64 and 156.28% average view percentage) significantly outperforming general tech or AI topics.
Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos on this channel, consistently generating 1,000+ views while long-form videos struggle to surpass 100 views.
The 'Myth vs fact' and 'Shocking fact first' styles perform exceptionally well for shorts, driving high retention and scores above 1.0 (e.g., Artemis Moon Rocket and Maglev Trains shorts).
Audience drop-off consistently occurs between the 4th and 8th second in shorts, indicating that hooks need to be punchier right at the start to prevent immediate viewer loss.
Call-to-action questions at the end of shorts are underperforming, as evidenced by frequent notes about zero comments; ending questions need to be more provocative to drive engagement.
Data for long-form videos is currently too thin (most under 100 views) to definitively prove which structural styles work best for long-form content.
